26-year-old man with a diagnosis of lymphoma. Whole-body 18F-FDG PET-CT (about 317 MBq, acquisition about 60 minutes after injection), contrast-enhanced CT.
Referta in ordine: accumuli fisiologici,: Report in order: physiologic uptake, disease, conclusion.
Nella PET-TC con FDG la prima domanda è:
In FDG PET-CT the first question is always: is this uptake physiologic? Brown fat (thermogenic adipose tissue) takes up FDG especially in young people, thin people and in winter: symmetric, often intense uptake in the neck, supraclavicular, axillary and mediastinal regions and along the thoracic paravertebral muscles. The key is the fused CT: the uptake falls on fat density, not on lymph nodes or bone.
In lymphoma, PET-CT is the staging exam (Lugano classification) and response exam (5-point Deauville scale, compared with mediastinum and liver). Anterior mediastinal lymphadenopathy in a young person suggests Hodgkin lymphoma or primary mediastinal lymphoma.
Accumulo simmetrico nel collo, nelle asc: Symmetric uptake in the neck, axillae or along the spine in a young person: look at the CT, if it is fat it is brown fat.
Linfoma (diagnosi primaria riportata nei: Lymphoma (primary diagnosis reported in the data of the FDG-PET-CT-Lesions collection; the subtype is not specified). The lesions segmented by the collection's experts are the mediastinal and supraclavicular lymphadenopathy; brown fat is not segmented.
Linfoma alla stadiazione: i reperti risp: Lymphoma at staging: the findings answer the clinical question; no urgent communication.

Nella fusione l'accumulo cade su densità: On the fusion, the uptake falls on fat density. Typical in thin young people and in a cold environment; it decreases by keeping the patient warm, with a beta-blocker or a fat-rich meal.
